paragraphs: Play! Pokémon runs its events on three words: fun, fast, fair. The handbook applies at every scale, from a casual League night to a Championship Series stage.
Integrity is a shared job. Competitors, spectators, Judges, and Tournament Organizers are all expected to know this handbook and act by it.
trh-1.summary: The handbook binds everyone at a Play! Pokémon event — players, staff, and onlookers alike — to fun, fast, fair play.

paragraphs: Read alongside: the Standards of Conduct, Terms of Use, Inclusion Policy, Accessibility Policy, and the game-specific guidelines for whichever title you're playing (TCG, video games, GO, or UNITE). All live on the Play! Pokémon Rules and Resources page.
Everything is re-reviewed every quarter — re-check each document quarterly and consult the Summary of Changes section for what moved.
trh-1.1.summary: The handbook travels with a family of companion policies, all refreshed quarterly.

steps.action: Gather every deck list and team list at Championship Series events
Run legality checks at any moment, in any tournament phase
Cover a minimum of one deck or team in ten
steps.note: and as many beyond that as quality and pacing allow

trh-4.3.1.summary: Deck and team lists are gathered at every Championship Series event, and legality checking can happen whenever staff choose.
